hooks.name: Validate AWS Accsess Key Credentials

action.prompt: The AWS credentials file was just edited. Run `aws sts get-caller-identity` to test if the credentials are valid. Report whether the credentials are valid (showing the account and ARN) or expired/invalid (showing the error message).

hooks.description: When aws-credentials/accesskey is saved, automatically validate the AWS credentials by running sts get-caller-identity
